release-smoke.description: Pre-release smoke: one quick native class per major area (casting, party, client fx, journal, meditation, wildlife, content, research, commands, monsters, lore, world, mounts and taming, network payloads, mixin targets). A fast sanity check run once before a release; it does not replace the per-area suites.

area-combat-bosses.description: Combat and bosses: damage gates, wild monster pressure, dungeon guardians, battlefields, sleeping blade, monsters, aura beasts, boss damage through armour, trees kept out of boss arenas, a Master gauntlet that ends with its world.

area-combat-arts.description: Combat: all fifty sword arts end to end (about 12 minutes on its own).

area-combat-aura.description: Combat: aura wards, sword strings, momentum and aura effects; bound-beast cooldowns reset with the server.

area-rituals-parties.description: Rituals and parties: relay circles, party admission during release, excise, basinfill and farm-spell casts, founding a guild and a coven, mentor tutelage while away, a Sanctuary sparing bosses.

area-regions-worldgen.description: Regions and worldgen: Siltcrest wetlands, rootmolt placement and attack cycle, fungal nursery, reed refuge, rainshield, rune-seal doors.

area-items-crafting.description: Items and crafting: research library, learn-all fusion, familiar content systems, Weaver's Silk stow key, casting gear loot, the backpack menu, the fusion altar menu.

area-guis-hud.description: GUIs and HUD: life journal, lore journal, quality settings, screen-effect setting and strain vignette, colour-blind-safe telegraphs, meditation, creature presentation, Cord loadouts.

area-feature-tour.description: Feature tour: broad screenshot walk through the mod's systems.

area-mounts-taming.description: Mounts and taming: book-tamed coffer mimics (follow, chest, pet, stay, save, spill) and berry-tamed thistle hedgehogs (sit, follow, heal, hoglets), and the first ride on a freshly tamed Ridgeback Stag (bond grows, remount starts fresh), and mount bond perks (level speed and health, the sprint-key dash, the landing strike sparing pets, kept through reopen, a new rider starting over), and the bonded skyray (the bridle call and its cooldown, flying along the look, slow falling on stepping off, lingering then leaving, one at a time, kept through reopen, unhurt by its rider, the fallen cooldown).

area-towns-guards.description: Towns and packet guards: the inn room chest shuts when its traveller walks off; the Cord screen inscribes no scroll for a spectator; an inn raid belongs to its own dimension; camp pot, bounty board, sunder and practice room entry state is forgotten when a world closes; every network payload survives its own codec round trip; homes, warps and /back keep their warmup, cooldown, cancels and home limit; a named-elite bounty sets one marked champion loose 48 to 96 blocks out, and only the hunter's kill of it counts; an escort bounty hands over a tough, chested pack llama on a lead, abandoning it drops its cargo, arriving pays out, a dead llama loses the bounty and one left from an earlier escort loses nothing and is taken back; a wandering caravan camps 24 to 40 blocks off with its two pack llamas, sells a stranger two runes and saffron, keeps a traveller's stock, never camps beside another and moves on when its stay ends; a Room Key lets a room only beside a keeper, a second adds its days, the traveller wakes there after dying with room and chest kept, and a stay that runs out ends; a bell is a hamlet only with three villagers about it, greets the traveller, earns standing from a trade and nearby kills up to a day's limit, makes them known with its favour and keeps it through a reopen.

structure-gallery.description: Structure gallery: every registered WilderCord structure found in its own biome on a fixed normal-world seed, placed through the registered path and photographed from above and inside. Visual evidence for the building work; not part of the gameplay suites.
